text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a fierce battle for first place, Oguri Cap clinches the victory at the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the battle to determine who's strongest has only just begun. Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross vow to meet again in the autumn Tenno Sho.
